report.title: Clicking 'Next' in 'Around the diner' gallery scrolls page to top without advancing slide

steps.target: Page viewport and Around the diner image

report.expected: Clicking the 'Next' button in the 'Around the diner' gallery advances the carousel from slide 1/6 to slide 2/6 while keeping the gallery in view.
report.actual: Clicking the 'Next' button does not advance the gallery (it remains on slide 1/6, showing the counter image) and instead scrolls the page all the way back to the top.
report.check: After scrolling down to the 'Around the diner' gallery on the About page and clicking the 'Next' button, window.scrollY returns to 0 and the gallery counter still displays '1/6'.

evidence.note: The 'Around the diner' gallery displays the first image ('The counter, twelve stools, same as 1974.') with counter '1/6'.
Scrolled to the bottom of the page; the 'Next' button is highlighted with a red border as it is interacted with, while thumbnail 1 of 6 is selected.

Immediately after clicking 'Next', the page scrolls upward while the gallery image remains the first image (red top with three white windows and counter stools) rather than changing to the second thumbnail.
The page finishes scrolling all the way back to the top ('A neighborhood counter since 1974'), and the visible top portion of the gallery image is still the first image.
